title: Database
description: A relational database schema, as loaded by DatabaseSpec.from_yaml. Top-level keys are table names (what a task's label query references in SQL); each maps to that table's keys, time column, curated columns and data file. Referenced by a task YAML's `database` field; one database YAML can back many tasks.

additionalProperties.description: One table. Null (bare 'name:') means all-default: no pkey, no time_col, no fkeys, file <name>.parquet.

pkey.description: Primary-key column. Omit for a table with no primary key (e.g. a pure link table).

time_col.description: Event-time column, used for temporal censoring. Omit for a static table (no time dimension).

fkeys.description: Foreign keys: local column name -> the table it references. The referenced table must be a key in this database and have a 'pkey'.

columns.description: Restrict the table to this subset of columns on ingest (the rest are dropped). Must include the pkey, time_col and any fkey columns.

path.description: Data file (.parquet or .csv). Defaults to '<name>.parquet'. Relative paths and the default resolve against from_yaml's data_dir (or the database YAML's own directory).
